name: Photos
description: Photos from a Google Photos shared album, one per screen update. Reading shared albums is unofficial: Google can change the album page at any time.

settings.label: Shared album link
settings.description: In Google Photos, open the album, choose Share, and copy the link. It looks like https://photos.app.goo.gl/… or https://photos.google.com/share/…?key=…. Anyone with this link can see the album, so it is stored as a secret. Large albums: only the first batch of photos on the album page is used.

settings.label: Change photo every
settings.description: A TV keeps its photo until the next change. Once a day changes at local midnight. Art Frames updates the TV image on its own schedule, so a change can show a little later.

settings.label: Check the album for new photos
settings.description: The layout reads the album in the background. Screen updates use the saved photos.

settings.label: Photo order
settings.description: Shuffle shows every photo once, in random order, before any photo repeats. Newest first goes from the most recent date taken to the oldest, then starts again.

settings.label: Photo fit
settings.description: Contain shows the whole photo over a blurred, darkened copy of itself. Cover fills the screen and crops the edges.

display_settings.label: Show the date taken
display_settings.description: Show the date the photo was taken in a small label in the corner.

display_settings.label: Show the time
display_settings.description: Show the time of the screen update next to the date. The time changes only when the screen updates.
